## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) show equity softness while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) and Industrials (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) show pockets of strength.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit signals modestly negative: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) ↓ falling implies credit pressure. Volatility is picking up short-term: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising, while commodities/energy (BNO / USO / XLE ABOVE TREND) are providing offsetting risk support.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) ↓ falling and LQD BELOW TREND point to modest tightening in rates/credit; SPY/SPY_TLT labeled NEUTRAL so no decisive loosening signal.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%). Tech lagging: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%), Financials mixed: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%); style skewed toward cyclicals over growth given energy/industrial breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) while EM/China show spotty signals — EEM RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) and FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) indicate selective regional strength but no broad global leadership.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Crypto/spot bitcoin firm: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%). Spec flows more cautious elsewhere: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) show reduced small-cap/speculative conviction.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Commodity complex strong and concentrated: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) point to commodity-driven reflationary forces while Gold GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) is more of a hedge.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy clear leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising; natural gas mixed: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) showing short-term bounce but month weakness persists.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W/1M both positive) and broad commodity ETFs confirming the move. MAJOR Divergence flagged across cores — SPY CORRECTION (1W vs 1M mismatch), XLK RECOVERY, and XLF CORRECTION (≥3 core ETFs with 1W ≠ 1M) — suppresses a strong regime call and keeps market transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor commodity/energy exposure given clear above-trend readings (BNO/USO/XLE), monitor tech (XLK/QQQ) which is fragile and reduce exposure to growth if weakness extends; bonds (TLT/LQD) remain under pressure so treat duration cautiously.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) and Energy commodities (BNO / USO ABOVE TREND) — watch if momentum holds.  
BEARISH: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) — watch for further tech pressure.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) — energy continuation risk.  
BEARISH: SLV RECOVERY (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -6.59%) and URA RECOVERY (1W: +5.16% | 1M: -9.76%) — metals/uranium remain vulnerable on monthly view.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (sentiment pivot for complacency), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health gauge), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY near recent support implied by CORRECTION reads.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, a mixed tape with clear energy/commodity leadership but narrow overall participation. Energy/commodities showing strength while tech/growth divergence (SPY/XLK/XLF 1W vs 1M mismatches) is the key risk to monitor.
